Original_Text:
Road to Green Valley Cut Off as River Floods Fields
The only road to Green Valley has been under waist-deep water since Tuesday, leaving about 400 residents without access to shops or clinics. Local volunteers say stocks of drinking water are running low.
They have asked the control room for water tankers, food packets, and two boats to carry the elderly to the relief camp. The water level is expected to stay high until Friday.
Expected_Keywords: under waist-deep water; drinking water; water tankers; food packets; two boats; the elderly; relief camp

Original_Text:
Blankets and Warm Clothes Needed at Sunrise Nagar Relief Camp
The relief camp at the Sunrise Nagar Community Hall is now sheltering 120 people, most of them women and children. Nights have turned cold and many families have only wet clothes.
Camp organisers have asked donors for blankets, warm clothes and baby clothing by Sunday. No medical help is needed, as the visiting doctor has already examined everyone.
Expected_Keywords: blankets; warm clothes; baby clothing; wet clothes; women and children

Original_Text:
NOTICE: Evacuation of Eastbank Ward
All residents of Eastbank Ward must evacuate to the relief camp at Sunrise Nagar Town Hall before 6:00 PM today. About 350 people live in the low-lying lanes.
Buses will leave from the market ground every 30 minutes. Elderly and disabled residents should contact the control room for boat assistance.
Expected_Keywords: evacuate; relief camp; Buses; boat assistance; Elderly and disabled; low-lying lanes

Original_Text:
Relief Distribution at Maple Lane School Ground
Food packets, drinking water and blankets will be distributed at Maple Lane School Ground on Saturday between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM. One packet will be given to each family on showing a household card.
Volunteers will deliver supplies to people who cannot walk. Trucks carrying supplies may be delayed because two bridges are flooded.
Expected_Keywords: Food packets; drinking water; blankets; distributed; Trucks; two bridges are flooded
Expected_Time: on Saturday between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM

Original_Text:
Seven Villagers Stranded on Rooftop at Silverstream Hamlet
Rescue teams are racing to reach seven villagers, including a pregnant woman and two small children, stranded on a rooftop at Silverstream Hamlet. A landslide has blocked the access road, and the water has reached the roof level.
The group has had no food or drinking water since Monday, and one child has a high fever. Officials said two boats and a medical team will leave at dawn.
